faq.a: Abdirahman is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن, whose core sense is abdirahman; servant of the most merciful.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdirahman?
faq.a: Abdirahman is associated with Arabic. Abdirahman is Arabic عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن (ʿAbd al-Raḥmān), meaning 'servant of the Most Merciful'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن is Arabic.
Abdirahman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdirahman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdirahman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdirahman is rendered عبدالرحمن and carries the sense عبدالرحمن، بنده رحمان.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-di-rah-man. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdirahman, abdirahman. Script forms are عبدالرحمن, عبدالرحمٰن, عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَن, अब्दुर्रहमान.
